title: Customer Quote Requests Tracker — Benchmark Report (Latency/$) Launch
content:
Purpose:
Collect customer/prospect proof points for the public-facing Benchmark Report launch (interactive page + PDF + blog + webinar + press/analyst kit). This tracker covers: candidate list, outreach status, quote drafting, approvals/usage rights, and which launch assets each quote can be used in.

Guardrails (must follow):
- No comparative claims vs named competitors in customer quotes (unless explicitly approved by Legal with substantiation and wording constraints).
- Avoid publishing exact numeric performance/cost claims inside quotes unless: (a) numbers appear in the report already, (b) customer confirms they are comfortable with public attribution, and (c) Legal signs off.
- Always get written approval for final quote text + attribution line + asset usage list.
- If customer is a prospect (not yet signed), treat as “prospect quote/testimonial” with extra scrutiny; default usage = private sales enablement only.
- If customer is in regulated space (health/fintech/legal), confirm any data residency/security phrasing with Security/Compliance (Naomi Feldman) and Customer Success.

Primary quote angles we’re collecting:
1) Latency predictability at p95 (not just average)
2) Improved latency/$ (unit economics) with batching/caching guidance
3) Regional consistency (EU/APAC) for global product experiences
4) Reliability under burst / graceful fallback
5) Deployment flexibility: Hosted → Dedicated → Private/VPC without replatforming

Status legend:
- Identified
- Intro needed (AE/CS)
- Contacted
- Discovery scheduled
- Drafting quote
- Sent to customer for approval
- Customer edits requested
- Approved (written)
- Declined / no response
- Blocked (legal/comms)

TABLE (most recent at bottom)
Columns:
Company | Primary contact | AE/CS owner | Relationship | Region | Product fit | Target angle | Requested attribution | Requested assets | Status | Approval received? | Legal review needed? | Notes / next steps | Last touch

1) Aurora Health (regulated healthcare AI vendor) | Priya Desai (VP Eng) | Jasmine Liu / Markus Klein | Prospect (Private/VPC) | NA | Private (VPC), audit logs | Compliance-ready private inference + predictable performance | “Priya Desai, VP Engineering, Aurora Health” | Sales deck (internal), Webinar (optional) | Discovery scheduled | No | Yes | They will not approve numeric claims; okay with “predictable latency” language if no patient/PHI mention. Need Security review language. | 2025-06-27

2) Northbridge Payments | Elena Karpov (Dir Platform) | Lukas Meyer | Prospect (Dedicated) | EU | Dedicated (EU) | EU region consistency + procurement-ready SLA posture | “Elena Karpov, Director of Platform Engineering, Northbridge Payments” | PDF, Landing page, Sales one-pager | Contacted | No | Yes | Interested in EU data residency. Wants to see final attribution line before agreeing. Offer option: company name only (no title). | 2025-06-25

3) HelixCode (devtools startup) | Jonah Kim (CTO) | Stephanie Nguyen | Prospect (Hosted → Dedicated) | NA | Hosted API, Dedicated sizing | Fast onboarding + predictable throughput | “Jonah Kim, CTO, HelixCode” | Blog, Landing page, Webinar | Drafting quote | No | Medium | They asked how to replicate results; keep quote focused on “time-to-value” and “steady p95 under load tests.” Avoid “best-in-class.” | 2025-06-28

4) OrbitAI (AI-native SaaS, cost sensitive) | Marisol Vega (Head of ML Platform) | Stephanie Nguyen | Customer (Hosted) | NA | Hosted API + Optimize guidance | Latency/$ improvement with batching/caching guidance | “Marisol Vega, Head of ML Platform, OrbitAI” | Landing page, PDF, Press kit (secondary) | Sent to customer for approval | Pending | Yes | Strong candidate; they specifically cited “lower cost per token at same UX.” Need to ensure no exact % in quote unless they provide + approve. | 2025-07-02

5) Vertex Logistics | Kenji Tanaka (Director, Product Eng) | Markus Klein | Prospect (Dedicated) | APAC | Dedicated capacity | APAC performance consistency for expansion | “Kenji Tanaka, Director of Product Engineering, Vertex Logistics” | Webinar, Sales deck (internal) | Contacted | No | Medium | They prefer “anonymous customer” public; offer: “Director of Product Engineering, global logistics company.” Confirm if acceptable for webinar Q&A. | 2025-06-21

6) Summit LegalTech | Amanda Cho (CISO) + Riley Shah (VP Product) | Markus Klein / Jasmine Liu | Prospect (Private) | NA/EU | Private (VPC), KMS/HSM | Security posture + auditability + performance transparency | Prefer anonymous | Sales deck (internal), FAQ | Blocked (legal/comms) | No | Yes | They require vendor security review before any testimonial. Likely internal-only at best. Keep in nurture; revisit post-procurement. | 2025-06-19

7) Cobalt Research (research lab) | Dr. Eli Rosen (PI) | Stephanie Nguyen | Prospect (Hosted) | NA | Hosted API | Reproducible methodology + transparency | “Dr. Eli Rosen, Principal Investigator, Cobalt Research” | Blog (methodology sidebar), PDF (appendix callout) | Identified | No | Low | Might approve a quote about “clarity of methodology” rather than product performance. Also asked about academic discount—route to sales. | 2025-06-14

8) Polaris Support Platform | Natalie Brooks (VP Engineering) | Jasmine Liu | Customer (Dedicated) | NA | Dedicated | p95 latency + streaming stability under peak | “Natalie Brooks, VP Engineering, Polaris Support Platform” | Landing page, Webinar, Sales deck | Customer edits requested | In progress | Yes | Their edit request: remove “streaming never fails” (too absolute). Replace with “stable streaming at peak traffic” + “fast incident response.” | 2025-07-06

9) (Backfill) Redwood Design Partner — NDA customer | (TBD) | Jasmine Liu | Customer (Private) | EU | Private | Deployment flexibility + control plane | Anonymous (“Head of AI Infrastructure, EU fintech”) | PDF, Landing page | Intro needed (AE/CS) | No | Yes | Candidate from CS list; needs internal confirmation of NDA constraints and whether anonymous quote is allowed. | 2025-06-12

10) (Backfill) Hosted API PLG power user | (TBD) | Ben Carter | Customer (Hosted) | NA | Hosted | Quick integration + consistent latency | Name OK (if approved) | Email, Blog | Identified | No | Medium | Pull from top activated cohort; target someone who used the benchmark link as an activation moment. Ben to propose candidates. | 2025-06-11

DRAFT QUOTE OPTIONS (for review + customer selection)
OrbitAI (option A): “We care about unit economics as much as raw speed. Redwood helped us improve latency-per-dollar without sacrificing the user experience, and the knobs for caching and batching are finally understandable.”
OrbitAI (option B): “The most useful part wasn’t a single number—it was being able to predict performance across real workloads and regions. That made our rollout decisions much easier.”

Polaris Support Platform (revised): “During peak traffic, p95 latency and streaming stability matter more than averages. Redwood has been reliable under load, and when we’ve needed help, the response has been fast and technical.”

HelixCode (safe phrasing): “We integrated quickly and could validate p95 latency under realistic concurrency within a day. That made it easier to decide when we needed Dedicated capacity.”

APPROVAL CHECKLIST (must be completed before publishing any quote)
- Final quote text approved in writing (email is fine)
- Final attribution line approved (name/title/company OR anonymous descriptor)
- Asset usage explicitly approved (Landing page / PDF / Blog / Press release / Press kit / Webinar / Sales deck)
- Any numeric claims in quote double-checked vs report and approved by Legal (Michael Grant / Sofia Mendes)
- For regulated customers: Security/Compliance review of wording (Naomi Feldman) if quote references security/compliance/data residency
- Store approval email link in notes field (or paste excerpt) for audit trail

OPEN QUESTIONS / TODO
- Need one EU customer quote that references “regional availability/consistency” without creating a data residency promise we can’t uphold.
- Need one Dedicated customer quote specifically about capacity predictability and SLOs (non-numeric).
- Confirm whether press kit can include customer logo list separate from quotes; if yes, create separate “logo permission” tracker.

NEXT STEPS (this week)
- Ethan: finalize 2–3 quote variants for OrbitAI + Polaris; send to Soojin for message-house alignment.
- Markus: move Vertex Logistics to anonymous quote option + confirm webinar participation appetite.
- Lukas: follow up with Northbridge on attribution preference + which EU region wording is acceptable.
- Legal: pre-approve a short list of safe phrases to speed turnarounds (e.g., “predictable p95,” “improved unit economics,” “regional consistency,” “production-grade reliability”).

Change log (manual):

- 2025-07-06: Added draft quote options and guardrails on numeric claims.
